_provenance.panel: THREE INDEPENDENT LLM RATERS (claude-opus-5), separate contexts, blind to model identity
_provenance.NOT_HUMAN: These are NOT the three human raters the proposal specifies. They are three independent automated raters. Inter-rater agreement between them is real and computable, but they are LLM judges and the paper says so.
_provenance.independence: Each rater received only the shuffled top-10 word lists and the rating rubric. No rater saw another's output, the model names, or the draft labels.
